orchestrator.reason: orchestrator==builder (opencode-go deepseek-v4.1-flash#max) by design: orchestrator routes, builder implements; no independence claim between them. Independence claim applies only to builder<->auditor<->hacker triangle.

release-engineer.reason: auditor/release-engineer share opencode-go glm-5.3-flash#high by design (verifier/deployer cost grouping); independence claim applies only to builder<->auditor<->hacker triangle; release-engineer vs auditor is intentionally allowed, hacker edges are enforced (families differ).

independence_scope.independence_claim: Enforced claim is builder<->auditor<->hacker triangle only: builder family != auditor, hacker-high, hacker-max; auditor != hacker-high, hacker-max; hacker-high != hacker-max (mutual, families minimax vs openai, enforced because cost allows).

intentional_cost_groupings.reason: orchestrator routes, builder implements; same model saves cost, no independence claim
verifier/deployer share cheap glm flash tier; independence claim applies only to builder<->auditor<->hacker triangle

independence_scope.note: orchestrator/builder same-model is intentional cost grouping (chosen over hard forbid); hacker-high vs hacker-max mutual forbid is enforced (chosen over document-allowed because families already differ, no extra cost).

enforcement.exempt_policy: skip edges listed in independence[role].exempt_edges; skip whole role when independence[role].enforced is false; enforced edges must be family-distinct

acceptance_author_role_note: Legacy singular 'hacker' is a deprecated alias for 'hacker-high' (backward compat). New capabilities must use a canonical enum value. 'human' means hand-authored outside the factory (family sentinel 'human'). Otherwise family is models.roles[canonical_role].family.
acceptance_author_family_note: capability.acceptance_author_family is derived as models.roles[canonical acceptance_author_role].family (human -> 'human'), never free text. If a capability records a non-default author (e.g. hand-authored deepseek), capability.acceptance_author_policy must name that canonical role and family must equal that role's family; auditor re-derives when family == builder family (deepseek). Default derived family for hacker-high is 'minimax'.
